title: July 2025 Release (v1.103)
description: July 2025 update to GitHub Copilot in VS Code (v1.103) focusing on making chat and agent workflows more reliable and easier to manage. Features include chat checkpoints, improved UI, better terminal interactions, and experimental features like task lists in agent mode.

community_feedback.quote: I don't understand how the latest Copilot release seems to have become much more expensive
Small business users burned through their quota in just two working days

title: Performance Optimizations and Organization Search
description: Released updates on July 31, 2025, including performance optimizations with better database query optimization, more reliable codebase information retrieval retry mechanisms, and organization switcher search for superusers.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor is kicking Devin's butt and is not even close
The feedback on Devin keeps rolling in, and it's not good

title: Critical Security Fix (CVE-2025-54135)
description: Critical security vulnerability addressed in Cursor version 1.3. CVE-2025-54135 (CVSS 8.6 HIGH) allowed attackers to run malicious code. Required immediate installation.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor is kicking Devin's butt and is not even close

title: Subagents Feature Launch
description: Claude Code launched subagents feature, allowing the system to delegate tasks to specialized subagents instead of a single Claude handling everything. This marked a major evolution in capabilities, described as the point when 'Claude Code became truly powerful'.

community_feedback.quote: Subagents are a slow token sink that only seems good at keeping...
Agents in claude-code are just ways to allow claude itself to launch subinstances where it runs tasks in separate context windows

title: Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite Model Release
description: Released gemini-2.5-flash-lite on July 22, 2025, a fast, low-cost, high-performance addition to the Gemini 2.5 model family.

title: New Copilot Chat Features GA
description: Several new Copilot chat features became generally available on July 9, 2025, including instant previews, flexible editing, issue management, improved attachments, and model selection capabilities.

title: Agent Mode Expansion
description: Agent mode reached general availability across multiple IDEs including JetBrains, Eclipse, and Xcode (previously available in VS Code). Agent mode is an autonomous AI agent that can research repositories, create plans, make code changes, and allow review of diffs.

community_feedback.quote: GitHub Copilot's new agent mode is capable of iterating on its own code, recognizing errors, and fixing them automatically
Many people using it because companies 'auto bought it' (classic Microsoft strategy)

title: Version 0.39 Release
description: Released Claude Code v0.39 with new Active Time metric in OpenTelemetry logging and Claude Code hooks for custom automation workflows.
